# Leia Baraza | Realtor

Leia Baraza is a licensed Realtor serving home buyers and sellers in the greater Sacramento region with local market guidance, home valuation support, buyer consultation, seller marketing, and neighborhood search resources.

## Core Pages

- [Home](/) - Overview of Leia Baraza's real estate services and primary buyer, seller, and search pathways.
- [Buy Your Home](/buy-your-home/) - Buyer questionnaire and guidance for people preparing to purchase a home.
- [Sell Your Home](/sell-your-home/) - Seller questionnaire for valuation, timeline, property details, and next steps.
- [Home Valuation](/home-valuation/) - Home value resource and external valuation call to action.
- [Marketing](/marketing/) - Seller marketing approach, including property websites, social media, photography, and tours.
- [Local Intelligence](/local-intelligence/) - Real estate posts, FAQ-style resources, and local market guidance.
- [FAQ](/faq/) - Answers to common Sacramento-area buying, selling, relocation, and neighborhood questions.
- [Contact Leia](/contact/) - Direct contact form and contact details.

## Service Area

Primary areas include Sacramento County, El Dorado County, Placer County, and Yolo County in California.

## Questions Answered

Who does Leia Baraza help?
Leia helps Sacramento-area home buyers, sellers, investors, and families relocating from the Bay Area.

What areas does Leia Baraza serve?
Leia serves Sacramento County, El Dorado County, Placer County, and Yolo County in California.

How can sellers start with Leia Baraza?
Sellers can request home valuation guidance, share property details, or ask about listing preparation and marketing.

How can buyers start with Leia Baraza?
Buyers can share their timeline, budget, financing status, preferred areas, and must-have home features.
